trigger: Parent reports original export refused runtime_file_metadata before emitting raw reference data, installation, unit start or native application calls. Original failed export remains retained.
scope: lstat-style metadata and bounded readlink strings under fixed /usr/lib/python3.12; no selected file body or symlink target is opened by diagnostic logic.
checked: Prunes site-packages/dist-packages and never traverses symlink directories.

Reports only relative path, type, owner, mode, link count and exact bounded symlink text for selected .py/.so/.pyc candidates that fail current scanner/read predicates; overlong text refuses rather than truncates.

Wrapper pins diagnostic, itself, frozen host helper and opaque transport; reuses64KiB/45-second response capture and -I/-S/-B interpreter; stores raw response privately and prints only execution receipt.
No arbitrary input path, app import, test, config/journal/signer access, filesystem write, network or service action is introduced.
No frozen helper or runtime scanner change is approved merely by this diagnostic review; actual outcome and any targeted correction require separate review.
